description: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun + Firestorm (via Proton with cnc-ddraw)
long: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun continues the GDI versus Nod conflict decades after the original, on an Earth increasingly mutated by spreading Tiberium. It introduced a new engine with deformable terrain, lighting effects, and a tech tree of futuristic units. This build bundles the Firestorm expansion and supports skirmish and LAN multiplayer.
name: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun + Firestorm
short: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun + Firestorm (via Proton with cnc-ddraw)
